objective_text: Describe the purpose of Azure Advisor
stem: Which tool gives personalized recommendations to improve the reliability, security, performance, operational excellence and cost of your Azure resources?
why_correct: Azure Advisor evaluates your Azure resources and makes personalized best-practice recommendations in those areas.
why_a_wrong: Service Health reports outages and maintenance, not best-practice recommendations.
why_b_wrong: Application Insights monitors the performance and usage of web applications.
why_d_wrong: Azure Arc extends Azure management to resources outside Azure.
author: claude

objective_text: Describe the purpose of Azure Advisor
stem: Which Azure Advisor category is about finding ways to reduce your Azure spending?
why_correct: The Cost category finds ways to reduce your Azure spending.
why_a_wrong: Reliability flags configuration risks so applications keep running.
why_b_wrong: Performance identifies changes that can speed up applications.
why_c_wrong: Operational Excellence suggests workflow and deployment improvements.
author: claude

stem: A company wants to know about outages and planned maintenance that affect the Azure services it actually uses, and to be alerted automatically. Which part of Azure Service Health fits?
why_correct: Service Health shows outages, planned maintenance and health advisories relevant to your environment, and you can set up alerts.
why_a_wrong: Azure status is a global picture of all services and regions, not tailored to what you use.
why_c_wrong: Resource Health looks at individual resources, such as one virtual machine.
why_d_wrong: Azure Advisor gives recommendations and does not report outages.
author: claude

stem: An administrator wants to know whether one specific virtual machine is running normally, and whether a problem is on Azure's side or their own. Which view helps?
why_correct: Resource Health shows whether an individual resource is running normally or has a problem, and whether the issue is on Azure's side or yours.
why_a_wrong: Azure status is a global view across all services and regions, not one resource.
why_b_wrong: Azure Advisor gives recommendations and does not show the health of a resource.
why_c_wrong: Application Insights monitors web application performance and usage.
author: claude

objective_text: Describe Azure Monitor, including Log Analytics, Azure Monitor alerts, and Application Insights
stem: An engineer wants to write and run queries against the data Azure Monitor collects, for example to find all errors in the last hour. Which tool is used?
why_correct: Log Analytics is the tool in the Azure portal where you write and run queries against the data Azure Monitor collects.
why_b_wrong: Azure Advisor gives recommendations and is not a query tool.
why_c_wrong: Azure Arc extends management to resources outside Azure.
why_d_wrong: Cloud Shell is a browser-based command shell and not a query tool for monitoring data.
author: claude

objective_text: Describe Azure Monitor, including Log Analytics, Azure Monitor alerts, and Application Insights
stem: A team wants an email when a virtual machine's CPU stays above 80 percent. Which feature does this?
why_correct: Azure Monitor alerts notify you when a condition you defined is met, for example a metric such as CPU staying above 80 percent.
why_a_wrong: Advisor recommendations suggest improvements and are not condition-based notifications.
why_b_wrong: ARM templates deploy resources and do not monitor them.
why_c_wrong: Azure Arc extends management to resources outside Azure.
author: claude

objective_text: Describe Azure Monitor, including Log Analytics, Azure Monitor alerts, and Application Insights
stem: A team wants to track response times, failure rates and page load times of its web app, and run availability tests. Which Azure Monitor feature fits?
why_correct: Application Insights is an Azure Monitor feature that monitors the performance and usage of web applications, and it can run availability tests.
why_b_wrong: Resource Health shows the health of an individual Azure resource, not application response times.
why_c_wrong: Azure Advisor gives recommendations and does not monitor application performance.
why_d_wrong: Budgets track spending and do not monitor application performance.
author: claude

objective_text: Describe Azure Monitor, including Log Analytics, Azure Monitor alerts, and Application Insights
stem: In an Azure Monitor alert, what controls who gets notified and what happens next?
why_correct: An alert rule defines the condition, and an action group controls who is notified and what happens next.
why_a_wrong: A resource lock stops resources being deleted or changed.
why_b_wrong: A budget sets a spending limit and does not control alert notifications.
why_d_wrong: A policy initiative groups related policies to track compliance.
author: claude
